lines.text: I think it's better to park Tata here before we figure out what's going on inside.

scenes.summary: The giant Aggelos is defeated. A tender sapling sprouted in the midst of the Great Originium Oak's remains.

lines.text: Look. A sapling just sprouted from the ground!
Indeed. Just like the sapling nurtured by Granny Jenner in the camp.
It sprouted from the heart of this Great Oak's stump. I believe the tree has answered your call, Endministrator.
Does that mean the Great Oak lives again? This is like the best thing ever! It's gonna make everyone in Camp so happy!

options: It's not like the other branches. This one looks alive...
Let's pray that the sapling grows to be a strong tree.

r: It's not like the other branches. This one looks alive...
Let's pray that the sapling grows to be a strong tree.

scenes.summary: The land is yet unhealed but a beauteous Originium geode has grown over the wounds. This may have something to do with your past.

lines.text: We've finally reached the end of it!
Wow! Just look at this place...
According to the earlier records, these formations were probably created during that explosion.
It was the only option they had. It left a wound that never healed, even to this day.
I guess fate brought everything together!
After all these years, this place has returned to what it looked like before the Originium Oak. No one could have foreseen this.
Endmin, your past self left a choice here.
That past self probably did not realize that, after all these years, the same choice would create a path for us on this day...
So yes, fate has indeed brought everything together.
But ... there were times when I felt that everything was just...
Simply unimaginable... To think that such resplendent beauty lies beneath the scar.

options: Was I ... responsible for this as well?

r: Was I ... responsible for this as well?
